IS 19085 : 2024 Glass Containers for Homoeopathic Pharmaceutical Preparations - Specification
ICS 11.120.99
ICS 11.120.99
AYD 07
AYD 07
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the materials, requirements and testing methods of glass bottles used for different dosage forms in homoeopathy.
This document applies to phials, drop-dispensing glass bottles and screw-neck glass bottles used in homoeopathic pharmacies. Together with the corresponding closure systems, they are used for packaging and dispensing of homoeopathic pharmaceutical preparations in solid and liquid dosage forms.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
